verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching automated import is a community remark praising Bevy's Asset V2 preprocessing and .meta files, which implies per-asset settings and processing without manual clicking. First-party docs mention only glTF loading and hot-reloading of textures, meshes and scenes. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the asset processor/preprocessing pipeline, import hooks or custom processor APIs, preset/.meta settings details, batch pipeline scripting, and hands-on corroboration.
